title: Hatsune Miku — Time To Cheer!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Ahem! Hello, everyone!
Welcome and thank you for coming☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's time to kick off the Miku-tastic Wonder Sports Festival♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now I'd like to pass things over to KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you and hello, everyone. I'll be your MC for today's show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Our lovely plushies have been divided into two teams, Team Red and Team White.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa and company will even be joining them as support members...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Tsukasa and Emu, you'll be on Team Red.
Rui and Nene, you'll be on Team White.

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for having us☆

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Welcome! Victory will be ours!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll try our best.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As for me, I'll be cheering you all on with my flower friends♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Singing Flowers
rows.Line: Go, Team Red! You can do it! Team White! Stand and fight!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! I'm getting pretty pumped up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Indeed! Now, our first event will be...
The scavenger race!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The lists are scattered around the plaza, so please pick whichever you like!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you're having trouble finding what you need, try looking for a treasure chest! You may just get lucky♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Treasure chests...? Interesting.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now, on your marks...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Get set... GO!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Scamper... Scamper...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Flap... Flap...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tanuki and Birdie are both off to a good start!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah☆ Woohoo! Go, go, go!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hehehe☆ I've gotta run after them and keep cheering them on!)
Team Red

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There! I found Team Red!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! We have our list!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have to get a... Merry-go-round?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! But it's up in the sky!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hold on! These events usually have you look for glasses or something small like that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hahaha! I knew they'd be shocked!)

rows.Speaker: Miku & Singing Flowers
rows.Line: You can do it, Team Red! Go, go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, we've got Miku and the flowers rooting for us! How about we try and ride the merry-go-round?

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Yay! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hang on, why are you...?! Hey, wait up!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I wonder when they're going to notice the treasure chests. Hehehe, this is so much fun♪)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Okay, time to go and cheer the other team!)
Team White

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm stumped... It says Steam Train...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: It's so high up in the sky... Maybe this one's impossible...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, this is quite the conundrum.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perhaps we should look for a treasure chest instead, as Miku suggested.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That's Rui for you! He's a quick learner!)

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Hey, I found one already! Look!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What's inside...? Ah, it's a toy Ferris wheel.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe there's a toy steam train in one of the other treasure chests?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hehe! Nene's team got it figured out!)

rows.Speaker: Miku & Singing Flowers
rows.Line: Go, go, Team White!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The winners of the scavenger hunt are... Team White!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, you did it♪ Go Team White!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Dang...! How were we supposed to guess that those toys were hidden in the treasure chests?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No matter! We just have to win the next one!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's get the next one, Tanuki!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here we go! Both teams are getting fired up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Our next event will be the...
SEKAI Stamp Rally!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Each attraction has its own stamp, but each team must get them in order!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene, & Rui
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I'll be right behind you with some Miku-tastic encouragement!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, but Miku...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you sure you only want to be cheering? Everyone else is having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Today, I just want to see them all smile♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe, I see.
Then you'll just have to cheer your heart out!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come on, flowers! Let's go♪
